shared_elements: frontal figure with arms held at chest
border or framing band of repeated pattern
relief carving filling the whole field of an upright stone
justification: Both show upright monuments carved in relief with human figures rendered frontally, wearing prominent headgear, and both include a framing/patterned border and an animal element, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A depicts a single dominant standing personage swathed in dense, ornate curvilinear regalia and glyph-like blocks covering the entire surface, while B shows a tiered composition of three small schematic weapon-bearing figures in a register above a large profile quadruped with a rider — different subjects, different compositional logic and utterly different ornamental conventions.
